decision: owned-request path retained as the recommended large-message boundary; borrowed responses are not faster in this shape
head: 10f3cd07
conclusion: For 256-KiB unary messages the owned-request API removes the client copy and is 15.9% faster than the staged default. The .message unary response path now writes the 5-byte prefix and payload as separate DATA contributions; a follow-up run measured 406,003 ns versus 468,363 ns before the change (13.3% faster), so .message is no longer a response copy boundary. Owned responses remain the recommended path for callers that already serialize into prefix-reserved storage. The remaining default-path cost is the const-payload Writer clone on the request side.
